title: Preserve WebView table scroll on refresh
summary: Preserve WebView scroll position around refresh-start UI updates, document-layout shrink/expand cycles, and Completed/Pending table row replacement.
reason: Automatic and manual refreshes could occasionally leave operators at the top or a higher table position while browsing large Queue, Completed, or Pending tables.
behavior_before: Refresh captured scroll after the refresh-start UI changed, document restore skipped when refreshed content temporarily shortened the page, and Completed/Pending table renders did not have local wrapper-scroll preservation.
behavior_after: Refresh-start UI updates are scroll-preserved, document restore clamps to the nearest valid offset while content is shorter, and Completed/Pending table wrappers restore scroll through row replacement and deferred table enhancement passes.
tests_added: Extended tests/webview/test_webview_browser_large_table_smoke.py with refresh-style table scroll preservation assertions.
rollback_plan: Revert the scroll preservation changes in app.js, dom/table.js, completed/table.js, pendingPublishView.js, the two WebView smoke updates, and their regenerated summaries.
notes:
Clamp document scroll restores to the nearest valid offset after refresh layout changes.
Preserve scroll around refresh-start UI updates.
Update DOM scroll restore expectation for clamped document restoration.
Preserve Pending table wrapper scroll during row replacement.
Add refresh-style table scroll preservation coverage.
Preserve Completed table wrapper scroll during row replacement.
